question: What post-subagent completion contract should OpenClaw support, and how should it bound child output/history exposure plus announcement mutation, suppression, and delivery-result visibility?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the payload, ordering, timeout/error handling, redaction, audit behavior, and plugin authority are security-sensitive public API choices.

options.title: Design A Generic Delivery Hook
options.body: Add one bounded typed hook or equivalent delivery-boundary contract that covers child completion metadata, safe output access, delivery status, and explicit mutation or suppression semantics.

options.title: Fold Into Broad Lifecycle Hooks
options.body: Keep this issue open but resolve it through the broader lifecycle-hook design in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/43454.

options.title: Observation Only
options.body: Expose a non-mutating completion event and route announcement mutation or suppression to separate delivery-policy issues such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/13911.

recommendation.title: Design A Generic Delivery Hook
recommendation.body: Add one bounded typed hook or equivalent delivery-boundary contract that covers child completion metadata, safe output access, delivery status, and explicit mutation or suppression semantics.
